dana: Quick decision thread: post-launch follow-ups — which issues block the next milestone vs go into backlog. Short replies please.
ryan: From infra: embeddings 95p spike during canary, likely hotpath. I can own immediate triage.
nina: CS: two customers requested strict per-account caching guarantees. They said its blocking their production switch.
oliver: Product take: onboarding UI tweaks are low risk, schedule them. The caching ask feels like a customer-driven blocker if we cant offer a temporary workaround.
dana: Proposal: blocker = customer-impacting SLA breach OR reproducible behavior regression for >1% of requests. Mitigation allowed: per-account disable + model-fallback.
ryan: I'll add labels: severity:blocker, action:mitigate, scope:hotpath. Also will add an alert for 95p > baseline +200ms.
nina: CS will offer the per-account toggle as immediate workaround; will escalate if not available.
oliver: Owners: ryan triage, nina comms, dana roadmap. Timeline: triage within 3h, mitigation available in 24-48h, reconvene tomorrow AM.
cs-bot: note: canary deploy v2.1 started at 2026-05-04T01:12Z.
dana: Thanks all. I'll update the board with labels and put the follow-ups into sprint planning: hotpath fixes this sprint, UX polish next sprint.
